thread:
Jules: quick thread: after the PM retro, we want a lightweight remediation-checkin framework to stop items falling through the cracks. threw together a prototype.
Claire: share the prototype please. short and concrete pls.
Jules: pasted below. very small and strict: owner ack + two checkpoints.
```
T0: IC set, incident channel created, short outage note
T+24-48h: Owner assigned; owner must ack (ACK/REASSIGN/DECLINE) within 48h
Checkpoint 1 (T+5BD): short mitigation or rollback confirmed; if not, escalate to eng lead
Checkpoint 2 (T+15BD): sprintlet close window; either fix shipped, backlog ticket with assignee + due date, or escalate to program manager
T+30d: verification or closeout note posted
Monthly: recurring-pattern triage; label candidates for systemic investment
```
Dan: that looks doable. can we require the owner to add a one-line "risk note" on assignment? helps triage priority.
Jules: yes. owner line format: `ACTION | owner:Name;email | risk:low/med/high | SLA:5BD | ticket:#nnnn`
IC-bot: pro tip: set `remediation_checkin:true` and `owner_line:present` on the incident doc to activate the flow and pings.
Priya: comms cadence idea: initial alert -> 1hr update if high-impact -> 24hr summary -> 5BD check-in -> 15BD closure update. keep each update <= 3 bullets.
Claire: can we have SRE Bot nudge owners at 36h if no ack and again at 4BD before checkpoint1?
SRE Bot: yes. I will post automated nudges if incident doc has `auto_reminders:true`. I will also create a board card when `create_card:true`.
Dan: metrics to watch: ack rate at 48h, mitigation rate at 5BD, closure rate at 15BD, and repeat incident tags monthly.
Jules: rollout suggestion: pilot with 8 incidents across teams for 6 weeks. compare metrics vs last quarter for P1/P2.
Priya: I'll own the dashboard. Claire, can you draft a one-page PR for /docs/incidents that contains the template, owner line format, and bot flags?
Claire: yup. will draft and ping for reviews. target PR in two working days.
Jules: thanks everyone. small ask: include an FAQ blurb for PMs: what they can expect to see and how to escalate.
Dan: +1. also include IC coverage rules (no more than 2 IC weeks per quarter per person).
IC-bot: log: proposal_submitted -> remediation_checkin_framework by Jules @2278904321
Jules: closing thread; PR link will follow.
